text:
leo_partner: hey team — our customer is ready to start the co-sell sandbox next Tue. need staging tenant + SSO + a quick daily cost estimate for legal.
nina_sales: great. can we keep this to a 10-day sandbox? partner prefers short window.
omar_ops: duration OK. reqs: 2 reserved GPUs, 8 vCPU, 512GB storage, 250GB egress cap.
zoe_eng: recommend model rwd-3b-lowlat for the sandbox to keep perf predictable. enable prefix cache and set max_batch=8.
leo_partner: can you confirm latency targets? customer wants sub-150ms 95th for short prompts.
zoe_eng: with that config we should hit ~120ms p95 for 64-token requests.
riley_security: quick heads-up: security questionnaire section on key management is outstanding. who will supply text about KMS?
zoe_eng: put this: "Customer keys are supported via customer-managed KMS (AWS/GCP). For Private deployments we support HSM/BYOK. All persistent model artifacts and logs are encrypted AES-256."
leo_partner: thanks. also they asked if we can forward audit logs — they need SIEM integration during the trial.
omar_ops: we can forward CloudTrail-style logs to an S3 endpoint or syslog. for the sandbox we'll do S3 push to partner bucket (30-day retention) — need partner write creds.
leo_partner: i'll get creds tomorrow.
deploy-bot: Sandbox tenant request #S-1284 logged by nina_sales  status: pending-provisioning. assignee: omar_ops.
omar_ops: blocker: partner's firewall blocks outbound to our metadata endpoint. please allow outbound 443 to auth.sandbox.redwood.ai and test with `curl -v https://auth.sandbox.redwood.ai/.well-known/openid-configuration`.
leo_partner: adding firewall rule now, will run the curl and paste output.
nina_sales: procurement needs a one-line daily estimate for the SOW. can ops give a single number we can pass to them?
omar_ops: ballpark daily: $420/day for the reserved infra + $0.03/GB egress up to cap. send that and note final invoice after actual usage.
leo_partner: perfect will relay.
riley_security: small ask: add this line in the questionnaire about pen tests: "Redwood performs quarterly penetration testing; results summary available under NDA."
zoe_eng: added that to the draft.
leo_partner: next steps: omar to provision tenant once firewall verified; leo to send creds; zoe to enable model + cache; riley to attach questionnaire snippets. target: tenant live by Tue 09:00 PST.
nina_sales: i'll coordinate PO and loop in procurement. thanks everyone :rocket:
